verdict.rationale: Bun documents a lockfile (bun.lock), a --frozen-lockfile flag that installs exact locked versions without updating, a global content-addressed cache with hardlinking to node_modules, and automatic migration from other lockfiles, all directly supporting reproducible installs across machines. Community evidence corroborates monorepo/isolated install reliability improvements, though some report install crashes/bugs in edge cases (old lockfiles, WSL/Windows switching). Missing for 10: independent benchmark/hands-on verification that resolved versions are byte-identical across OSes/machines beyond docs and anecdotal community reports.
